The '''1985–86 [[La Liga]]''' season was the 55th since its establishment. It began on 31 August 1985, and concluded on 20 April 1986.

[[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] lost their defence of the title to [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]], who won the title by an 11-point margin.

This season marked [[Valencia CF|Valencia]]'s only relegation from La Liga to date.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.levante-emv.com/deportes/2014/05/11/peor-temporada-valencia-descenso-1896/1110442.html|title = La peor temporada del Valencia desde el descenso de 1986|date = 11 May 2014}}</ref>
